sections.name: sections
sections.runtimeType: { id: string; title: string; order: number; content: string; type: "overview" | "procedure" | "reference" | "troubleshooting" | "faq" | "examples"; prerequisites?: string[]; estimatedTime?: number; difficulty?: "easy" | "medium" | "hard"; }

procedures.name: procedures
procedures.runtimeType: { id: string; title: string; description: string; steps: { stepNumber: number; instruction: string; expectedResult?: string; screenshots?: string[]; tips?: string[]; warnings?: string[]; }; prerequisites?: string[]; tools?: string[]; estimatedTime?: number; difficulty?: "easy" | "medium" | "hard"; }

troubleshooting.name: troubleshooting
troubleshooting.runtimeType: { problem: string; symptoms: string[]; causes?: string[]; solution: string; steps?: string[]; prevention?: string; relatedIssues?: string[]; severity?: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical"; }

faq.name: faq
faq.runtimeType: { question: string; answer: string; category?: string; keywords?: string[]; relatedTopics?: string[]; }[]

glossary.name: glossary
glossary.runtimeType: { term: string; definition: string; category?: string; synonyms?: string[]; relatedTerms?: string[]; }[]

references.name: references
references.runtimeType: { title: string; type: "internal" | "external" | "api" | "document"; url?: string; description?: string; relevance?: "high" | "medium" | "low"; }

examples.name: examples
examples.runtimeType: { title: string; description: string; code?: string; language?: string; input?: string; output?: string; explanation?: string; difficulty?: "basic" | "intermediate" | "advanced"; }

screenshots.name: screenshots
screenshots.runtimeType: { id: string; title: string; url: string; description?: string; sectionId?: string; procedureId?: string; annotations?: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; text: string; type: "highlight" | "arrow" | "text" | "circle"; }; }

prerequisites.name: prerequisites
prerequisites.runtimeType: { type: "knowledge" | "software" | "hardware" | "access" | "skill"; item: string; description?: string; required: boolean; alternatives?: string[]; }

versionChanges.name: versionChanges
versionChanges.runtimeType: { version: string; date: Date; type: "major" | "minor" | "patch" | "hotfix"; changes: string[]; impactedSections?: string[]; backwardCompatible?: boolean; }

userFeedback.name: userFeedback
userFeedback.runtimeType: { userId: string; sectionId?: string; rating: number; comment?: string; helpful: boolean; suggestions?: string[]; submittedAt: Date; }[]

usageAnalytics.name: usageAnalytics
usageAnalytics.runtimeType: { totalViews?: number; uniqueUsers?: number; avgTimeOnPage?: number; mostViewedSections?: { sectionId: string; views: number; }>; searchQueries?: Array<{ query: string; count: number; found: boolean; }; lastUpdated?: Date; }[]

localization.name: localization
localization.runtimeType: { primaryLanguage: string; availableLanguages?: string[]; translationStatus?: Record<string, "complete" | "in_progress" | "needs_update">; culturalNotes?: string[]; }

accessibilityFeatures.name: accessibilityFeatures
accessibilityFeatures.runtimeType: { altTextProvided: boolean; keyboardNavigation: boolean; screenReaderFriendly: boolean; colorBlindFriendly: boolean; fontSize?: "small" | "medium" | "large"; highContrast?: boolean; }
